tools.name: search_ads
tools.description: Search TikTok/Facebook ads. Use extend_keywords for text; filter by AI creative type, active state, region, engagement, spend and dates. 1 credit per result.

type.description: 1=Ad keyword, 2=Ad copy, 3=Advertiser, 4=Landing URL, 5=Product, 6=TikTok shop, 7=App, 8=App developer, 9=Social account, 10=Creative, 11=Store/URL, 12=TikTok product

extend_keywords.description: Keyword search list. Each item has a type and keyword

search_type.description: Legacy search type; prefer each item's type in extend_keywords (1 through 12)

sort.description: Sort: 1=Last found, 2=Created, 3=First found, 4=Plays, 5=Days, 6=Engagement, 7=Like rate, 8=Share rate, 9=Likes, 10=Comments, 11=Shares, 14=Est conversions, 15-20=FB reactions, 21=Spend, 999=Keyword relevance (use after for next page)

create_time_start.description: Creation time range start (unix timestamp in seconds)

create_time_end.description: Creation time range end (unix timestamp in seconds)

data_type.description: Data type filter: 1=Hot Product, 2=Mini Shop Ad, 3=E-commerce, 4=Spark Ads, 5=Game, 6=App, 7=AI, 8=Short Drama

is_url.description: URL status: 0=No landing page, 1=Has landing page

aigc_type.description: AI creative: -1=AI generated, 0=Non-AI, 1=Advertiser labelled, 2=Official AI. Omit for all.

after.description: Copy the complete cursor from the previous result. For sort=999 use [last _score, last video_id].

is_and.description: Combine keyword items with AND (true) or OR (false, default)

exclude_word.description: Excluded keyword items; wire parameter is exclude_word

tools.name: get_ad_detail
tools.description: Get detailed info for a specific ad by video ID. 1 credit (free if queried within 3 days).

id.description: Ad video ID (video_id from search results)

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search e-commerce products advertised on TikTok/Facebook. Filter by keyword, price, category, region, ad metrics. 1 credit per result.

search_type.description: Search type: 1=Product title, 2=Product description, 3=Advertiser URL, 4=Advertiser name, 5=Product keyword

category.description: Product category, multiple separated by commas

region.description: Country/region, multiple separated by commas, e.g. "US,GB"

tiktok_time_start.description: Ad start date / first found time start (unix timestamp)

tiktok_time_end.description: Ad start date / first found time end (unix timestamp)

latest_found_time_start.description: Ad end date / last found time start (unix timestamp)

latest_found_time_end.description: Ad end date / last found time end (unix timestamp)

sort.description: Sort field: 0=Start Date, 1=End Date, 2=Product Creation Date, 3=Price(USD), 4=Number of ads, 5=Impressions, 6=Likes, 7=Durations

store_id.description: Store ID (13-char string) to filter products from a store

time.description: Time range shortcut: 1=yesterday, 7=last 7 days, 30=last 30 days, 90=last 90 days
